> 4 page(s) of developer.paypal.com documentation — Braintree — Docs — Guides under Overview. Part of the index one level up (../llms.txt).

## Overview

- [Overview](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/docs/guides/payment-method-types-overview): The guides in this section will show you how to add specific payment method types to your Braintree integration.
- [Payment Method Nonces and Single-Use Payment Methods](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/docs/guides/payment-method-nonces): In the SDKs, a payment method nonce is a secure, one-time-use reference to payment information.
- [Payment Methods](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/docs/guides/payment-methods): Your integration may be impacted by upcoming certificate changes. Visit our to learn more.
- [Transactions](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/docs/guides/transactions): Your integration may be impacted by upcoming certificate changes. Visit our to learn more.
